title: Ask holy company to hold you close
summary: Longing is steadied when spiritual companions hold it close together. Take the question into sangat.
lifeApplication: When the mind starts wandering alone, move toward the company that steadies it instead of asking isolation to save you.

source.shortMeaning: Longing is steadied when spiritual companions hold it close together.
source.lifeApplication: When prayer thins out, ask one companion to stay near and carry the line with you.

evidence.coreClaim: Longing is steadied when spiritual companions hold it close together.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: holy company teaches the heart how to remember well.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the mind starts wandering alone, move toward the company that steadies it instead of asking isolation to save you.
